title: Scythe: The Rise of Fenris
subtitle: The 8-Episode Alternate-History Dieselpunk Campaign
tagline: Unravel the secrets of the mysterious Factory across an 8-episode replayable campaign of warfare and diplomacy.
loreSummary: Empires rise and fall in the alternate 1920s of Europa. As the shadowy Fenris faction emerges and the mysterious city-state known as The Factory reopens its subterranean vaults, the great nations must mobilize colossal dieselpunk mechs, forge delicate alliances, and struggle for continental supremacy across 8 evolving episodes.
keyFeatures: Replayable 8-episode narrative campaign with persistent wealth and technology upgrades
11 modular components unlockable for standalone play after campaign completion
Two brand-new factions and customized Annihilator mechs housed in secret tuckboxes
Compatible with all previous Scythe expansions, including 7-player modes and airships

scythe_fenris_full_campaign.description: The complete narrative campaign experience spanning all 8 episodes, secret box unboxings, and the continental climax.

scythe_fenris_expanded_chronicle.name: Extended Chronicle & Modular Battles (12 Episodes)
scythe_fenris_expanded_chronicle.description: The full 8-episode campaign plus 4 post-campaign standalone modular battles utilizing unlocked factions and rules.
